- Maximum APR cap: 15% to 20% APR (competitive lender bidding during 7 to 14 day window)
- Repayment horizon: 90 to 95 days (early repayment allowed at any time with zero penalty)

## Exact On Chain Capital Allocation (10,000 USDC Total)
1. Arbitrage operational liquidity: 6,000 USDC (60%). Base stablecoin liquidity and market neutral DEX and CEX spread execution with zero directional leverage.
2. Dedicated RPC and WebSocket nodes (3 months): 1,500 USDC (15%). Institutional Alchemy and QuickNode plans for mempool streaming and low latency execution.
3. Gas reserve and private bundles: 1,400 USDC (14%). Gas coverage across Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, and Ethereum Mainnet including Flashbots private bundles.
4. Dedicated low latency VPS servers (3 months): 600 USDC (6%). Cloud servers co located near RPC endpoints in US East Virginia or Frankfurt for 24/7 uptime.
5. On chain transparency portal and smart contract: 500 USDC (5%). Deployment and maintenance of LoanTransparencyRegistry.sol and this read only public invoice tracker.

## Repayment Guarantee (Real World Daily Cash Flow)
Principal and accrued interest repayment do not depend solely on arbitrage bot yields. Repayment is backed 100% by daily billing across three active non crypto businesses:
1. Full stack software, web applications, and Web3 smart contract engineering.
2. Architectural and interior design services.
3. Construction and remodeling project execution.

## Smart Contract Verification
- Contract file: contracts/LoanTransparencyRegistry.sol
- Lifecycle states: PreFunding, Active, Repaid, Defaulted.
- Enforcement: Immutable upper cap per USDC category; every logged expense stores vendor, USDC amount, timestamp, Ethereum transaction hash, and immutable IPFS invoice receipt CID.
- Pre funding honesty: Prior to reaching the 80% funding threshold on Unlloo, logged spend displays 0.00 USDC with zero simulated transactions.
